name: github
description: A GITHUB sidebar tab listing the active repo's open pull requests and issues, with a "Start work" action that creates a worktree session for one — optionally priming an agent on it. Backed by the `gh` CLI; no credentials of its own.

github.worktreeLocation.description: Where a "Start work" worktree is created. {repo} is the repository root, {branch} the branch name (path separators in it replaced with '-'). Same convention as the bundled Worktrees extension.

github.agents.description: Agent presets offered by "Start work", as a JSON array of {name, command}. Leave as [] to skip starting an agent — just the worktree session.

github.sendAutoSubmit.description: Submit the issue/PR context to the agent immediately after "Start work". Off (default) types it into the pane for you to review before pressing Enter — the agent's own launch command is always submitted either way.
